Now that you have §aEpoxy§r, you can make §aAdvanced Circuit Boards§r! The next Circuit tier is oh so close, so keep pushing.

§9§lTips:§r

- Consider using §dElectrotine decomposition§r and §dOre Processing§r for §eElectrum§r.
- Consider using the §3Chemical Bath§r with §dMercury§r for §eGold§r, from a wide variety of ores.
The §6System-on-Chip§r (or §bSoC§r) is a specialty component that miniaturizes all the typical circuit components (like SMDs) onto a single chip.

These are very useful as they unlock the most efficient recipes for creating §6Refined§r, §6Micro§r, and §6Nano Circuits§r.

Each SoC-based circuit recipe requires a different minimum tier of §aAssembling Machine§r, with the Nano Circuits requiring you to hit §dLuV§r. §aSystem on Chip§r unlocks the best recipe for §dLV Circuits§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.more_ev_circuit:
Nothing to say here.

Nice work, we suppose.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.more_iv_circuit: Set sail, IV is on the horizon
Entering §1IV§r with these Circuits shouldn't be too painful.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.nor_gates.title: NOR Gates
phoenix_chronicles.quest.nor_gates.descr:
A NOR gate takes two input signals, and outputs a high signal only if both input signals are low.

This doesn't matter for now though, and it's simply a more complex wafer.
It is used for the §aData Orb§r (a key component for when you get into §3Research§r), and in §5Nano§r Circuit production.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.first_luv_circu: Save two of these for the §3IV Circuit Assembler§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.ev_superconduct: Amperage goes up - we're now at a whopping §e6A§r per Superconductor (12 if using §5Source Titanium Fillament§r).
phoenix_chronicles.quest.advanced_energy:
The §aAdvanced Energy Detector§r is an RS-latch for Energy Control.

Slap it on a §3Battery Buffer§r, set a Minimum EU near 0, and a Maximum EU near the max capacity.

The Cover will output a §4Redstone§r signal until the high threshold is reached, and then it will wait until the low threshold is reached to output redstone again.

This is a must to automate inertia-based power generators such as Boilers, or more importantly §3Large Turbines§r.
You can now remotely expand your AE2 network if you're looking to move bases.

A full set of two §3Quantum Tunnels§r is no slouch to craft, so you'll need to break a sweat if you want them.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.uranium_refinem: Let's hope this quest doesn't put you on a list

Make §dUranium Hexafluoride§r from §aUraninite§r. This will allow you to seperate the isotopes between U-238 and U-235.

---


§9Fluorine§r is fully recycled in the reaction, but you will need around maybe 40 buckets to bootstrap.

§9Hydrogen§r is consumed, so you will need quite a lot of it. Either electrolyze a lot of water using several §3LV Electrolyzers§r for the best energy efficiency, or recycle any unused §dhydrocarbons§r such as Methane.

§9Tip:§r You can make this setup compact by having one single §3Centrifuge§r and using a §6Fluid Regulator§r set to §dSupply Exact 1,000§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.radon.title: Radon
phoenix_chronicles.quest.radon.subtitle: 200 seconds?! WHAT?!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.radon.descripti:
Don't worry, this is nothing compared to running an EBF.

Hopefully for you, the §3LCR§r recipe in §2EMI§r for §aRadon§r should be self explanatory on how to set it up.

Input some §aUranium§r, loop back the §dPlutonium§r using a §3Electric Furnace§r, and let the magic happen.

§l§3Lore:§r§o This cursed yet charming "chain" is inherited from GregTech 5. Plutonium 239 existing as an ore is a sort of a placeholder to avoid having to obtain it through complicated means.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.epoxy.title: Epoxy
phoenix_chronicles.quest.epoxy.subtitle: Prime circuit board material
phoenix_chronicles.quest.epoxy.descripti:
§aEpoxy§r is the foundation for all future Circuit Boards in the game. Get ready to make a lot of this stuff.

§9§lNote:§r This questline is quite complicated, so tackle everything else before trying to make Epoxy. You'll need all the help you can get!

---


There are several ways to obtain the ingredients for §aEpoxy§r.

We'll ignore recipes related to Glycerol, as they're never worth it unless modpack devs tweak things around. §mHint hint, if you're making your own pack!§r

Try and use §3Large Chemical Reactors§r to shortcut recipes.

---


§dChlorine§r is only partially recycled, so you'll need a constant supply. Feeding it manually should be sufficient at first.

Recipes involving §dSodium Hydroxide§r could be looped by electrolyzing the §9Salt Water§r co-product.

Doing this will probably require you to make some Quadruple Pipes, Pump Covers, Fluid Filters... or route everything using AE2.

In general, closed loop setups are nice to prevent overproduction or overconsumption, but go for whatever's more fun for you.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.epichlorohydrin:
You're going to want to use the §3LCR§r recipe for your first §aEpichlorohydrin§r.

This recipe requires §aPropene§r, which means that §dOil Processing§r and §dFuel Cracking§r are now necessary ventures. We're truly sorry if you've been dragging your heels!

It's quite important that you make your first §3Distillation Tower§r before progressing to the right.

Last of all, if you haven't noticed, you can loop the §dSalt Water§r byproduct to bootstrap the §dSodium Hydroxide§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.phenol.title: Phenol
phoenix_chronicles.quest.phenol.subtitle: But that's just how I Phenol
phoenix_chronicles.quest.phenol.descript:
Obtain §aPhenol§r from:

§91 -§r §aWood Tar§r distillation.

§92 -§r Reacting §aBenzene§r with §dChlorine§r and §dSodium Hydroxide§r This should be performed in an §3LCR§r, and the Chlorine is perfectly looped.

§93 -§r Shortcutting the above recipe by ignoring the §dSodium Hydroxide§r. This is net negative on §dChlorine§r.

§94 -§r Reacting §aBenzene§r, §dPropene§r and §dOxygen§r using a small amount of §4Phosphoric Acid§r - normally a catalyst, but consumed here in small quantities. This is called the Cumene process.

---


If you're having trouble deciding between the options presented, here's the appeal of each route:

§91 -§r Great if you're willing to set up a §3Pyrolyse Oven§r + §3Distillation Tower§r combo.

§92 -§r This one's our preference! You can use the §dSalt§r to make more §dSalt Water§r, then electrolyze to create a loop.

§93 -§r Very appealing if you have an infinite supply of §dChlorine§r. You could achieve this by setting up a §3Fluid Drilling Rig§r on a Salt Water vein.

§94 -§r ...§4Phosphoric Acid§r is a pain to produce. You'd be mad to consider this.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o The Benzene + Oxygen recipe was added in GTCE with the intent of fixing missing chemical recipes, as the Large Chemical Reactor didn't exist. Now that CEu provides more realistic options, we may remove the recipe in future.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.acetone.title: Acetone
phoenix_chronicles.quest.acetone.descrip:
While distilling §aWood Vinegar§r gives §aAcetone§r, the yield is low and might not meet your needs.

You might want to use the direct §3LCR§r recipe from §aAcetic Acid§r to obtain §aAcetone§r.

If you want to be fancy, you can also use the good old §aAcetic Acid§r -> §dDissolved Calcium Acetate§r -> §aAcetone§r loop, which does not require a §3LCR§r, but still recycles the Calcium compound perfectly.

---


We've been talking about Acetic Acid, but we're yet to tell you how to obtain it. Wouldn't that be great?

§aAcetic Acid§r can be synthesized in the §3Chemical Reactor§r. Our favorite recipe is from §dEthylene§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.silicone_rubber:
Silicone Rubber has its uses in Cable insulation, Conveyor recipes, and more.

You may want to shelve this quest for now, as tackling Silicone Rubber can be a pretty severe §dChlorine§r sink.

---


§9Note:§r Rubber will eventually be usurped by either §aSilicone Rubber§r or §aStyrene-Butadienne Rubber§r for §1IV§r Cables.

Both these rubbers will be required once you make it to §dLuV§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.styrenebutadien:
§7Styrene-Butadiene Rubber (SBR)§r is an enhanced type of Rubber.

It can be used in place of Rubber in most recipes, and is §6four times more efficient§r at §ainsulating Cables§r. It is also strictly required for certain higher-tier recipes.

This isn't exactly worth making until you get the §3Distillation Tower§r, but it eventually becomes easier with §dFuel Cracking§r.

---


§9Note:§r Rubber will eventually be usurped by either §aSilicone Rubber§r or §aStyrene-Butadienne Rubber§r for §1IV§r Cables.

Both these rubbers will be required once you make it to §dLuV§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.gasoline.title: Gasoline
phoenix_chronicles.quest.gasoline.descri:
§aGasoline§r is an extremely powerful Combustion Fuel. It's over §63 times§r as energy dense as §dDiesel§r!

§9Note:§r This Combustion Fuel exists solely as a §echallenge§r for you to overcome if you desire to take on it.

It's completely §doptional§r, so we'll let you figure out how to obtain it, without any further tips.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.high_octane_gas:
§6Multiply the energy density by 2§r and you have §aHigh Octane Gasoline§r.

§9Note:§r Automating this requires a lot of §3Distillation Towers§r! A huge portion of your base would be dedicated to producing this constantly without anything bottlenecking.

If you have a base successfully running on §aHOG§r, feel free to brag and share some screenshots on our §8Discord§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.distillation_to: Time for a real oil refinery!

The §3Distillation Tower§r is a multiblock that will help you extract the most out of fluids. In §3Distilleries§r, you had to pick only one product to output. DTs output §6all of it at once§r!

§9Note the special placement rules:§r Energy, Items, and Fluid Inputs can only be placed on the bottom layer. Maintenance can be placed anywhere. Fluid Outputs can only be placed starting on the second vertical layer, and only allow one per layer as well.

---


The §3DT§r can form at any height from §c§c3§r to §c13§r blocks, allowing 2 to 12 Fluid Outputs. Fluid will always output on the layer corresponding to the recipe in §2EMI§r.

The §3DT§r has one more §9special§r rule. You can deliberately build it too short, and it will §cvoid§r whichever Fluid should have been output at the top layers that were removed. This can be useful in some very niche situations.

It is a good idea to use §3Super Tanks§r as the output for every layer.

---


§cNote:§r Using the §3Distillation Tower§r for Oil -> Fuel -> Diesel is §cnot§r worth it! You will spend more energy overclocking the Multiblock than what you would get back from the products. It would be better to wait until you can make the §3Large Distillery§r (§1IV§r) for large scale Diesel production.

However, the DT is §6very valuable§r when extracting Cracked Fuels and Pyrolyse products.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.true_distillati:
§aLiquid Air§r is a great way to get large amounts of §aNitrogen§r and §aOxygen§r at the cost of using more energy than §3LV Centrifuges§r.

However, this will also give you both §6Helium§r and §6Argon§r - which are great to boost smelting in the §3Electric Blast Furnace§r.

§cNote:§r You will need at least §3HV Input and Output Hatches§r to be able to run this recipe.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.this_isnt_cryot:
Some specific fluids are §dCryogenic§r, which are too cold for ordinary pipes.

Thus... you need to pick the right pipe for the job.

Not many pipes support cold fluids, so you'll want to give §aStainless Steel§r or §aIridium§r a try. Later on you can use §aNaquadah§r or most of the fusion materials when you get there.

§cWARNING:§r§r Cryogenics in the wrong pipes will cause §cvoiding§r, §cpipe freezing§r, and high rates of §cdeath§r! Be careful.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o This is the first time GregTech has cryogenic mechanics, a GTCEu-original feature!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.true_distillati:
Here are the four most relevant §dHydrocarbons§r you will be obtaining from distilling Steam-Cracked Fuels.

You will want to set this up §lbefore§r moving to §1IV§r.

§aSteam-Cracked Light Fuel§r as input is probably the most favorable, but you are free to experiment.

We know what you're thinking - something along the lines of "§7§oThat Carbon output is just SO infuriating! It's ruining my automation!§r".

Enable Item Voiding (in the controller GUI) if you don't want to build an Output Bus.

This Quest requires the §3Pyrolyse Oven§r and is §doptional§r, yet convenient.

The first four fluids are the important products of §aWood Tar§r Distillation:
§9-§r Phenol: useful for Epoxy and PBI
§9-§r Benzene: an important hydrocarbon
§9-§r Toluene: useful for TNT
§9-§r Dimethylbenzene: useful for PBI

Unlike Oil, putting §aWood Tar§r in the §3Distillation Tower§r for the byproducts, and using §dNitrobenzene§r for power is arguably worth it.

---


The bottom three are the important products from §aWood Vinegar§r Distillation:
§9-§r Acetic Acid: useful to make more Acetone
§9-§r Methanol: a moderately important hydrocarbon
§9-§r Acetone: useful for Epoxy and Gasoline

---


It's also possible to use a "full combo" of 4 §3DTs§r -  input §aCharcoal Byproducts§r into a first tower, splitting into §aWood Tar§r, §aWood Gas§r and §aWood Vinegar§r.

This isn't the most efficient cost-to-production ratio, but the option is there if you get bored.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.multiblock_crac:
The §3Cracker§r is a multiblock built with the sole purpose of cracking fluids. It comes with all the recipes of §3Chemical Reactor§r Cracking, but it is §6lossless§r.

This is a great way to save a lot of Fuel in the long term!

Higher Coil tiers provide a small energy discount - up to 70% with the best Coils available.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.item_p2p_tunnel: A primer on items and P2P

To turn a P2P Tunnel into an §aItem P2P Tunnel§r, right-click it in the world with a §dvanilla Chest§r.

Item P2P Tunnels are useful in a more abstract way so let's start with an example.

---


§eExample:§r Making a §9HV Machine Hull§r in the §3Assembler§r also requires an §3Extractor§r for the Fluid. That is two machines, hence two inventories.

You could passively fill the Assembler with Polyethylene, §lor§r you can also include it in your §dPattern§r, in the form of 2 Bars (Ingots).

You may think the next step is just to dump the items in a Buffer and route the items with Pipes - however, this system will eventually §4jam§r due to the incompability with AE2 Interface blocking mode! Oh no!

---


This can be fixed by placing the input of the §aItem P2P§r on your §3ME Interface§r, placing one output on the §3Extractor§r, and another output on the §3Assembler§r.

Then, use Filter covers where the outputs are connected. §dItem Tag Filters§r are better, since you can configure them to §9ingot§r. Have them on §ewhitelist§r for the §3Extractor§r, and on §eblacklist§r for the §3Assembler§r (no Assembler recipe ever requires Ingots - that's an intentional design decision in GregTech).

Don't forget §dBlocking Mode§r on your Interface.

Look - another reason why it's good to store polymers (Polyethylene, PTFE, PBI) as Bars!
The §aAlloy Blast Smelter§r is the only main §2GCYM§r machine available in §5EV§r. You can use it to produce any alloy that you'd normally use the Mixer for.

Instead of producing §6Hot Ingots§r, the ABS produces §9Molten Fluids§r if the recipe is "hot" enough. These fluids require cooling with a §bVacuum Freezer§r. Otherwise, it produces regular liquids.

Don't let the long smelting times scare you off. This machine incorporates the §dMixer step§r directly into the smelting recipe, and actually saves you quite a bit of time over smelting the dust in an EBF!

Nearly every §2GCYM§r material is produced in this machine, so if you have trouble finding a Mixer recipe, look for a Molten Fluid!

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o This multiblock was inspired by GT++. It didn't use any heating coils, had no temperature requirements, and only produced regular liquids for all materials. It was pretty OP back in the day, but it eventually got restricted to only a single Energy Hatch to balance it out. For some reason, it also allowed you to melt any dust... into liquid...?
phoenix_chronicles.quest.getting_rid_of_: Getting Rid of Those Old Machines

You probably have some old machines lying around, right?

You most likely know by now that Arc Furnaces can recycle machines, so use them to get some materiels back!

§eNote§r: This quest accepts either an §5EV§r or §9IV§r Arc Furnace. You don't have to make both.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.multiple_fluid_:
Need to handle §6multiple§r fluid inputs and outputs? Look no further - these §aFluid Hatches§r can handle more than one fluid at once!

These cannot be used in a §bDistillation Tower§r, but may be particularly useful in §5Large Chemical Reactors§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.platinum_group_:
The §aPlatinum Group Metals§r are six rare metals with useful catalytic properties. In no particular order, they are §3Ruthenium§r, §dRhodium§r, §7Palladium§r, §9Osmium§r, §bIridium§r, and §ePlatinum§r.

You will need to §4automate§r their processing lines, as every single one of these metals will be used extensively in the late game.

---


To begin, treat various PGM-bearing §aPurified Crushed Ores§r with §dNitric Acid§r to produce §aPlatinum Group Sludge§r.

Then, centrifuge it with §dAqua Regia§r to produce the various PGM salts.

§dChlorine§r can be perfectly recycled from the §eRaw Platinum Powder§r.

§dNitric Acid§r is §osort of§r recycled from §7Raw Palladium Powder§r through §dAmmonia§r, though we'd recommend keeping the excess Ammonia for other uses (Rocket Fuel and PBI).

The other PGM salts have their own special mini-chain associated to them - more on this in the next quests.

---


§9Note:§r §ePlatinum§r and §7Palladium§r can also be obtained from The End or through normal Ore Processing.

§l§3Lore:§r§o Heard of the infamous "Platline" from either Gregicality or GregTech: New Horizons? The extremely daunting chain was added in GT:NH through Bartworks. The concept is amazing, but we had to tune it down significantly to make entering late game in GTCEu much smoother.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.ruthenium_and_r:
This part of the chain starts with §aInert Metal Mixture§r.

The §dSulfuric Acid§r will be perfectly recycled. You will also produce excess §dOxygen§r and §dHydrogen§r that can be stored.

§aRuthenium§r and §aRhodium§r will gate your progression into §9IV§r and §dLuV§r respectively. If you automate them now, you won't need to do it later!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.iridium_osmium_: Hold your fire just for now

Yo, a quick note on §aIridium§r and §aOsmium§r.

We know, it's technically possible to obtain these materials now, but you should wait until you reach §9IV§r. Producing these materials will suck up a lot of your precious power... and you won't be able to smelt them into ingots until §9IV§r anyway!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.better_flight.s: Quite the microcrafting project... but worth it
phoenix_chronicles.quest.better_flight.d:
The Advanced Nano Chestplate combines protection, a personal battery and an §6enhanced Jetpack§r, all in one.

To §denable charging§r, sneak right-click with it in your hand, then equip it (There may be an occasional bug where it refuses to charge, but you'll forgive us, right?).

Note that this stores §oa lot§r of energy, and uses it fairly fast. You may want to invest in a §3HV Turbo Charger§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.pattern_p2p_tun:
The §aPattern P2P Tunnel§r is an upgraded version of §9Item/Fluid P2P Tunnels§r.

The input side is placed on an Pattern Provider containing patterns. It can have multiple outputs, which should connect to inventories.

When multiple crafts of a single pattern are requested, the P2P Tunnel will evenly distribute the crafts between all of the connected outputs.

The Pattern P2P Tunnel also respects §eBlocking Mode§r, which is set in the interface containing the patterns.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.reservoir_hatch: This hatch acts like an infinite water source for multiblocks! It can make some setups much more convenient, and also has effectively infinite throughput, so it doesn't have the limitations of the §9Infinite Water Source Cover§r not being fast enough.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.heat_exchanging:
The Heat Exchanger is a machine that takes in hot fluids from fissile proceses like §o§2Medium Pressure Fissile Steam§r§r or §cCrtical§r steam. It can also cool down some advanced coolants such as sodium potassium.


§7(Side Note: Balancing power generation, is tricky. If you notice any issues or have suggestions, we'd love to hear them in the Discord!)§r
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_3d22de5ce497d:
Your journey takes you to the §3Moon§r, anticipating vast resources. However, the lunar surface proves largely §7desolate of useful ores§r. Instead, you must learn to tap into parallel dimensions to extract the truly valuable materials.

This powerful §6multiblock§r is engineered exclusively for §bspace environments§r. (Remember, you'll need the Dimensional Anchor for non-space dimensions!) To access these extra-dimensional space veins, prepare a §6Space Grade Steel Drilling Kit§r and the unique §cVoidic Drilling Fluid§r.

From these hidden realms, you can obtain crucial ores like §ePlatinum§r, §eIgnisium§r, and §eMagnetite§r. However, for now, its paramount purpose is to secure §5Voidglass Shards§r – essential for your §bVoid Touched Tungsten§r.

A word of advice: Always use the §aSpace Mining Module§r to significantly boost your yield from these exotic recipes!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_689182d74cd2b:
§3The Space-Resistant Alloy§r
This is the crucial material you need for your §cTier 1 Rocket§r and the §3Space Grade Steel Drilling Kit§r.

We hope you've already established your §atungsten processing§r, and have some of that custom §bHV superconductor§r, §bIcy Steel Matrix§r, left over. These vital dusts are used to alloy with other metals, forging this incredibly §aspace-resistant metal§r.

Not much else needs to be said. §eEnjoy space!§r
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_533a98a019b5d:
§eAurum Steel Drill Kit:§r The most basic, this gets you §aOverworld ores§r.

§bAluminifrost Drill Kit:§r This second kit unlocks §cNether ores§r.

§dFrost Reinforced Stained Steel Drill Kit:§r The third in line, designed for §5End ores§r.

§3Space Grade Steel Drill Kit:§r This fourth kit yields §bMoon ores§r along with some §6custom ones needed to progress later§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_2a7eb67677b93:
Oh, Ok. This §o§3is§r rocket science, but don't fret; it's quite manageable! This component is absolutely vital for constructing your §afirst rocket§r, and every one thereafter.

The recipe itself is straightforward: a few §bHV material plates§r combined with some §eEV components§r. However, the true challenge lies ahead, as you must now prepare to build your §crocket§r itself...
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_2274ac3bba5de:
With your §eNASA Workbench§r now complete, the true preparations for your journey to the stars begin! It's time to gather critical supplies: secure plenty of §arocket fuel§r and forge ample §espace grade steel§r.

For each new destination, a dedicated §claunch pad§r is essential. Furthermore, you'll need vital §boxygen gear§r, including a §bspace suit§r and §bgas tanks§r. (A word of advice: securing these is highly recommended if you intend to return from your travels!)
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_06f7673cdefcd:
The §3Dimensional Anchor§r harnesses the power of §bparallel dimensions§r to extract §evaluable ores§r, requiring some §cBlazing Drilling Fluid§r as a cost. You'll need at least the corresponding §6drilling kit§r for each dimension you wish to tap. Hopefully, you'll also use the §aEarthbound Mining Module§r to significantly increase your yields. While this system can be §cexpensive§r to establish, its worth becomes §aevident over time§r.

Remember, the Dimensional Anchor must be built and operated within the §fOverworld, Nether, or End§r to process its associated recipes. For its space-capable counterpart, you'll need the §bAetherial Fabricator§r.



---



§6Unveiling Imaginary Materials§r
Learning of §cPhoenixForge Technologies§r has taught you many things, but one of the innumerable you've yet to learn is how they had so many seemingly §5imaginary materials§r. Thinking of this, you decide to wander around the remnants of §cPhoenixForge Technologies§r and discover they were harnessing the power of §bdimensions§r and the §binfinite void of space§r to pull resources from their deposits without being in the area. (it doesn't drain resources, it §a**generates**§r it!) Whilst you learn, you discover it's not one but §e**two machines**§r that did this: the §3Dimensional Anchor§r and the §3Aetherial Fabricator§r.
These modules significantly enhance your yields, providing §amore (and sometimes unique ores)§r than when doing the recipes without them. What more can one really say?

§aEarthbound Mining Module:§r Used to boost the recipes of the §3Dimensional Anchor§r multiblock.

§bSpace Mining Module:§r Used to boost the recipes of the §bAetherial Fabricator§r multiblock. You will §cneed this to progress to IV§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.iv_superconduct: So you're telling me an Ivy conducted this Super?
These Superconductors will be required for progression during §dLuV§r... when you delve deeper into §bResearch§r or §6Lasers.
phoenix_chronicles.task.iv_superconducto: samarium iron arsenic oxide single wire
phoenix_chronicles.quest.rare_earth.subt: It's got "rare" in the name... oh no.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.rare_earth.desc:
If you already made and centrifuged §aRare Earth§r, that's great! If you haven't, you can obtain it as a §9Byproduct§r from various ores, or from centrifuging §dMonazite§r.


---


The elements you can obtain are:

§9-§r §aLanthanum§r is used in §3Fusion§r§r - you will eventually want a lot of it!
§9-§r §aYttrium§r is used in §dYttrium-Barium-Cuprate-Oxide§r (YBCO), a wire material for §3UV§r.
§9-§r §aCerium§r is not particularly useful.
§9-§r §aSamarium§r is used for §dIV Superconductors§r and §dMagnetic Rods§r for §dLuV§r+ Motors.
§9-§r §aNeodymium§r normally makes the strongest magnets, but gameplay balance... y'know.
§9-§r §aCadmium§r is not particularly useful.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o Rare Earth Elements (REE) contain a lot more metals than these, but we're struggling as is to give them use.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.hssg_coils.desc:
§aHSS-G Coils§r bring up the Heat Capacity to §d5,400K§r.

The ever-tempting §6Coil bonuses§r§r should be high incentive to make those early, as they become mandatory only during §dLuV§r.

At this point, you may find yourself using only one §3Electric Blast Furnace§r for your entire base, powered with the highest available Voltage you can supply.

§6Hot Metals§r will start taking longer to cool down, as unlike your EBFs, the §3Vacuum Freezer§r doesn't get perfect overclocks. For that, you probably want a dual §7(or quad)§r §3Vacuum Freezer§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.hssg.title: HSS-G
phoenix_chronicles.quest.hssg.subtitle: This time, we're going at HIGH speed!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.hssg.descriptio:
§7High-Speed Steels§r (HSS) are resistant Steel alloys typically used in rails.

If you previously made §dUltimet§r for whatever reason, you've already acquired §aMolybdenum§r. Otherwise, it can be found in a Nether vein.

We hope you have a lot of §9Tungstensteel§r, because you're gonna need more! It's used for the creation of §aHSS§r alloys - in this case, §aHSS-G§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.hsse.title: HSS-E
phoenix_chronicles.quest.hsse.subtitle: Turbine Upgrade, perhaps?
phoenix_chronicles.quest.hsse.descriptio:
Technically, real-life HSS-E doesn't contain Manganese, but some other HSS alloys do have Manganese, so... close enough?

§aHSS-E§r has some niche uses in progression.

This alloy has great durability and damage property for tools. It has the best Power multiplier (until Neutronium!) as a §dRotor§r for §3Large Turbines§r, though it's slightly less efficient than §aHSS-S§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.extreme_combust:
When running the §3Extreme Combustion Engine§r, you're gonna want to boost it! §m§7Why bother otherwise?§r

Get yourself a §34A IV Dynamo Hatch§r as the output, and set up a §3Vacuum Freezer§r to provide §aLiquid Oxygen§r.

You should now be wielding the equivalent of 1 §dLuV§r Amp, all whilst burning fuel at §6200% efficiency§r!

Don't forget to keep it supplied with a small amount of §aLubricant§r.

The §3ECE§r is also void-free, unlike Large Turbines. Any energy that cannot be output will momentarily pause the multiblock.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o The ECE comes from GT:NH. However... its implementation wasn't so rosy at first. The stats on the tooltip looked similar to this one - so far, so good.

§oThe bad part came when crunching the numbers. Players ended up realizing they needed to run around 16 whole §6HV§f Vacuum Freezers to keep up with the Liquid Oxygen demand...

§oThe one and only fuel it would accept is High Octane Gasoline, which was stated to be burned at 300% efficiency when boosted, but the UI was lying. The efficiency remained at 100%.

§oThe GT:NH team eventually decided to rework the ECE among other power options... phew!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.polybenzimidazo:
You should have all the tools available to produce §aPolybenzimidazole§r on your own! Good luck - it's a 14-step process, and it's no slouch at that.

§aPBI§r only becomes mandatory to progress from §dLuV§r to §cZPM§r, but tackling it earlier will unlock the §6Advanced SMDs§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.advanced_smds.d:
Better §aSMDs§r? SMDs that'll unlock far cheaper §7- §8and faster §7-§r Circuit recipes? We're sold!

These'll require Alloys that you haven't made yet, most of which will be commonly used in §dLuV§r and onwards. Get on it!

Whilst you don't need these right now, §aAdvanced SMDs§r will become a hard requirement for the §dCrystal§r Circuit line. Note that using these in your current circuits will §2halve§r the recipe duration.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.iv_assembler.de:
Tungstensteel under your belt? Nanoprocessor Mainframes on demand? Let's make some machinery.

The §3IV Assembler§r is required to unlock §3IV Energy and Dynamo Hatches§r, as well as §3HSS-G Coils§r.

Upgrading this to its §2GCYM§r variant isn't a bad idea.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o Did you know that GTCE's content stopped at §5EV§r§o, and all content up to §3UV§f was provided by Shadows of Greg, a third party mod?
phoenix_chronicles.quest.laminated_glass: Another Polymer Rises From The Darkness

§aLaminated Glass§r is the shiny new tier of Glass for §9IV§r and above. It's made in the §3Forming Press§r using a polymer you won't be familiar with: §dPolyvinyl Butyral§r.

None of the steps should be particularly difficult if you already have the §3Distillation Tower§r for Cracked Fuels, and you have also automated Epoxy.

If you don't already have both set up, you know what to do!

§9Note:§r §dPolyvinyl Acetate§r (required for the Glass) can also be used for §aGlue§r!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.hsss.title: HSS-S
phoenix_chronicles.quest.hsss.subtitle: We made this one up
phoenix_chronicles.quest.hsss.descriptio:
HSS-S is another §mcompletely fictional§r §7High Speed Steel§r, alloyed with Iridium and Osmium.

§aHSS-S§r will be necessary to craft §dLuV Motors§r.

This alloy has a great mining speed, which translates into extremely good §6efficiency§r when used as a §dRotor§r in §3Large Turbines§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.indium.title: Indium
phoenix_chronicles.quest.indium.subtitle: Superconductor Supreme
phoenix_chronicles.quest.indium.descript:
Getting §aIndium§r requires a lot of §dSulfuric Acid§r, and two different ores: Galena and Sphalerite.

§dSulfuric Acid§r can be produced in large scale in the §3Large Chemical Reactor§r, or obtained as a waste from the §9Platinum Group Sludge§r process.

In §dLuV§r, the mandatory §9Naquadah chain§r will grant §aIndium§r too, which means this setup will have a limited life.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o This is another small chain inherited from GregTech 5. However, this used to yield one tiny Dust instead, which was... interesting.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.high_power_inte:
The §aHPIC§r unlocks §3IV Energy Hatches§r and §3Dynamos§r... You know the drill!

Making an §3IV Chemical Reactor§r is §doptional§r. You can craft this with a §3Large Chemical Reactor§r if you wish.

If you wish to automate your LCR with patterns, circle back to the P2P Tunnel Quest for more information.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.there_is_no_lim: ...and if you disagree, you'll see the light soon enough

§9IV§r Components - fortunately for you - aren't a massive step up in terms of complexity.

However, the amount of §dTungsten§r required in crafting these is huge.

§aEmitters§r and §aSensors§r are in their own league, as they require §dNether Stars§r and §dIridium§r, both of which have their own dedicated Quests.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.shredding_your_: Shredding your Ores with further more Byproducts

Better Ore Processing for §6chanced Byproducts§r, only at the cost of this §3Macerator§r! A must have.

And now, it's finally time for mass ore processing automation.

The next Quest will kick things off!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.setting_up_ore_:
Welcome to the age of automation!

Ore Processing is now at your fingertips.

§6This quest unlocks a definitive tutorial on Ore Processing in the §lTips and Tricks§r§6 tab - check it out to learn more!§r
phoenix_chronicles.quest.assembly_line.d:
Making §dLuV§r Components will require more work. You'll need to make an §3Assembly Line§r in order to progress.

This Multiblock has a §evariable size§r§r. Each §3ULV Input Bus§r along the bottom can only hold a §dsingle stack§r of items, so you'll need different lengths for different recipes.

You'll want to build this with a size of §d10§r to get started, or of a size of §d14§r to accept all possible recipes in base GTCEu. §6Don't worry§r if you overbuild - it can run any recipe if it's too long, but you may find the casings quite §4expensive§r right now. §7Choices, §8choices!§r

---


Recipes here will require §aFluids§r, so it's a good idea to keep the §3Input Hatches§r permanently filled with §dSoldering Alloy§r, §dLubricant§r and §dStyrene-Butadienne Rubber§r.

§6This quest unlocks two new tutorials on the Assembly Line and Research in the §lTips and Tricks§r§6 tab - check them out to learn more!§r
phoenix_chronicles.quest.insane_batterie:
§o§7"250,000,000 EU in a Battery? That's 25 minutes of Power when drained constantly."

The §aLapotronic Energy Orb§r should be the beginning of the end of your energy storage struggles.

This form of Energy Storage is perfect if your Power Generation is inconsistent, or if you need to buffer large amounts due to the nature of §3Large Turbines§r.

Such a boost in power does not come cheap. Each §dLapotronic Energy Orb§r is worth §a8 Lapotron Crystals§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.first_zpm_circu: The §aZPM Mainframe§r is used to make the §3LuV Circuit Assembler§r (of course), but also allows you to step into §3Fusion§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.nether_stars.de:
§aNether Stars§r are used for high tier §dSensors§r, §dEmitters§r and §dField Generators§r.

You can also use them for §dBeacons§r if you desire the permanent potion effects. Finally, a vanilla multiblock!

We've added a recipe for Nether Star Dust in this pack. §7(Yes - without any tweaks, GTCEu expects you to farm Withers ad nauseam.)
§r
On the topic of the §aNether Air§r which is required in the recipe: take a look at §9Liquid Nether Air§r distillation at your own leisure. It's quite rewarding.

§o§8Did you know the vanilla Nether Star texture isn't centred? :)
phoenix_chronicles.quest.iridium_and_osm:
This part of the chain starts by obtaining some §aRarest Metal Mixture§r.

You'll need at least an §9IV§r §3Large Chemical Reactor§r, but the average power draw isn't too bad.

§dChlorine§r is fully looped, and §dHydrogen§r is slightly negative §7(§ounless you put Acidic Osmium Solution in the Distillation Tower and electrolyze the water back... §8on second thoughts, don't do that§r§8).

§aIridium§r is required to progress through §9IV§r, so get your PGS line automated ASAP!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.resonantrhodium:
Congratulations on making it this far!

Progressing into §dLuV§r will require more than §aResonant Rhodium  Alloy§r and §9LuV Circuits§r alone. You'll also need the §3Assembly Line§r.

The §4resource costs§r for components will also start to increase §4significantly§r as you work towards §eFusion§r.

If you haven't got automation for nearly everything, now (in §1IV§r) is a good time to do it. Take advantage of the power granted by §2Gregicality Multiblocks§r!

If your power generation relies on §3Large Turbines§r, you can pick up the §3LuV Rotor Holder§r.

If your power generation relies on fission, you can soon make the first breeder line.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.multiblock_mine:
This Large Miner is nearly identical to the regular one, except it has a wider range and uses more drilling fluid.

It's an optional upgrade - one you might not even need!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.power_substatio:
The §3Power Substation§r is a multiblock power storage system. Fill it with §a2-18 layers§r of assorted §9Capacitor Blocks§r to increase its storage. Each layer must be full of capacitors, and you can use Empty Capacitors to fill unused spaces.

§9Capacitors§r also hold significantly more energy than the batteries used to make them. In the §3Power Substation§r, §9Capacitors§r can be mixed, so they do not all have to be the same tier.

At §1IV§r, you can make §5EV§r and/or §1IV§r Capacitors.

---


Energy can be inputted with regular Energy Hatches, and output with regular Dynamo Hatches.

You can also use §9Substation Hatches§r to transmit many more amps. These hatches only work in Substations, and do not work in regular multiblocks.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.qubit_cpus.subt: This actually has no relation to Quantum
phoenix_chronicles.quest.qubit_cpus.desc:
We know... this isn't actually gated behind §dIndium§r. However, you gotta trust us - this is the better recipe, so we don't want you wasting your time.

§aQubit CPUs§r are used in the production of §1Quantum§r Processors.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.iv_circuit_asse:
Woah! It's been tough to get here. You'll appreciate not having to make a new polymer for Circuits Boards.

The §3IV Circuit Assembler§r unlocks the §1Quantum§r Circuit line.

This also unlocks the §6best recipe§r for §dMV Circuits§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.extreme_circuit:
The next Board for the §1Quantum§r Circuit line.

§9Tips:§r For efficient and fast board production, you should use two §3Large Chemical Reactors§r, both supplied with §6HV§r power or higher (make them both share the same §3Energy Hatch§r):

§9-§r One §3LCR§r should be dedicated to §aIron III Chloride§r. The §dHydrogen§r is loopable, so reproduce §dHydrochloric Acid§r locally - that way, you'd only need to passively input §aIron Dusts§r and §aChlorine§r.

§9-§r One §3LCR§r should be making both the §acoated Boards§r and the §aempty Circuit Boards§r to make future §ecrafting requests§r with AE2 extremely easy. Keeping an Input Hatch full of Sulfuric Acid shouldn't be a problem, either.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.best_ev_circuit:
The first Circuit of the §1Quantum§r line. This is the last "easy" circuit line - things are about to get hectic.

If you wish, you could go even further and aim for §dAdvanced SMDs§r to make these Circuits cheaper.

Doing so will require §9PBI§r... and Alloys that require §aHSS-G Coils§r in your EBF.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.rocket_fuel.sub: Honey, where are my Microverse Projectors?
phoenix_chronicles.quest.rocket_fuel.des:
Rocket Fuel mostly exists for compatibility with other mods. You'll love it if you're making your own pack.

As an actual fuel for GTCEu generators? Terrible!

In this modpack, §aRocket Fuel§r is required to obtain §dNether Stars§r.

Automating it may be a big hit to your resources, but you can safely batch craft using an overclocked §3Large Chemical Reactor§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.fiberreinforced: The biggest upgrade you've ever seen

The next board material.

It's as easy as using some §aEpoxy§r in the §3Chemical Bath§r.

§8Anyone in favor of this getting reworked?
phoenix_chronicles.quest.more_luv_circui: Good news for any mainframe haters out there - §dLuV§r Circuits that aren't mainframes!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.even_more_iv_ci:
Better §9IV§r Circuits.

Your march through §9IV§r continues. Stay strong, soldier.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.upgrading_your_: Upgrading your EBF for the millionth time
This is second nature at this point

This Quest will be completed with §eeither§r an §3IV Energy Hatch§r§r... or an §3IV Dynamo Hatch§r for your Multiblock Generators.

Don't forget that §d4 Amp§r variants exist! However they require §aNiobium-Titanium Cables§r, which need §9Polyphenylene Sulfide§r.

Look down in the §dLuV§r Chapter for that (don't worry... it's easy to obtain).
phoenix_chronicles.quest.iv_cutting_mach:
The §3IV Cutting Machine§r is required to unlock §3IV Energy and Dynamo Hatches§r.

Upgrading this to its §2GCYM§r variant isn't a bad idea.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.quarktech.title: QuarkTech
phoenix_chronicles.quest.quarktech.subti: No, we didn't trademark this one
phoenix_chronicles.quest.quarktech.descr:
This armor provides more QoL compared to the Nano suit.

§9Helmet:§r Provides §dNight vision§r (default keybind §4M§r but check for conflicts), prevents harmful potion effects, and automatically eats for you!

§9Chestplate:§r Nullifies burning, but can be further upgraded into the §aAdvanced§r version at the very end of §dLuV§r. Note that this does NOT include a jetpack without the advanced upgrade.

§9Leggings:§r Provides the speed boost which the Nano leggings did not.

§9Boots:§r Provides §dStep Assist§r, nullifies fall damage, and increases jump height!

§9Full Set:§r Provides §dSpace Immunity§r: allowing you to breathe easy!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.the_mallet_to_e: The Mallet to End All Other Mallets
Life would be boring without silly quests...
§bPolybenzimidazole§r is the best material for §6Soft Mallets§r in vanilla GTCEu. Show us that you're on top of your PBI supply by spending some of it on a §dsuperfluous tool upgrade§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_2fcc0401afd92: The main structure of the matrix

These fill in the space of the outside of the matrix after you build the frame. You can also use the matrix glass in lieu of the walls if you want.

You need §l§9150 of these§r so batch accordingly.

Good luck, you might need it!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_2f67f502bad01:
These provide no benefit beyond just replacing the walls, allowing you to §9see in§r.

They are not any cheaper, but they are §apretty§r!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_207036e606b32:
Now that you have everything else to make the matrix, you need §l§968 of these frames§r.

You place a §3skeleton of a 7 cubed area§r with the frames, then you fill in the faces with either §9assembler matrix glass§r or §9walls§r.

Inside the assembler matrix is where your §bcores§r are and it needs to be completely full without any air gaps. Once it's built, you connect it to your §aAE2 network§r and you are good to go!

(A slight note here: you can make the matrix bigger than 7 cubed, you just will not have to do so in pretty much all cases. However, it is an option to keep in mind for later.)
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_2df05c03b33c5: Pattern the world, and own it.

This is where the actual meat of the matrix lies, where you store your §3patterns§r!

Each of these hold §l§6twice the amount§r as an extended pattern provider to allow you to §oreally§r go crazy.

You need at least §9one§r to allow you to actually craft resources, but you can choose the amount you want beyond that. The consensus is usually to start with §l§930§r as the §bcrafting speed/parallel§r will be your main focus. Moreover, you can always upgrade later.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_6437514df0a2c:
These allow the crafts you run in the §3assembler matrix§r to run in tandem, letting them complete even faster!

The general advice towards the amount you want in a §67 cubed matrix§r is §l§990 of these§r with the rest being filled up with pattern and §95 speed cores§r.

You can also change the amount of these versus pattern cores as they are not locked to a certain number.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_5190b80adcb35: Kicking up the speed of your crafts!

These speed cores allow the speeds in the §3assembler matrix§r to increase. The maximum benefit is §95§r, so don't make more as they will just be taking up space.

As fewer of these are needed, the craft to make them is a lot more expensive.

However, I highly suggest you make them.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.true_beauty_beg: True Beauty Begins With Many Impurities
And if you don't think so, you will see eventually.

This material came from my original story about the §35 Universal Wanderers§r. §l§9Pure Nevvonian Steel§r is capable of slicing through anything (including stories), perfectly fitted to the wielder, and is unbreakable.

The more impure alloys are found throughout universes, each version slightly changing the name.

Here, this slightly §6impure Nevvonian Steel§r is used to make the §3assembler matrix§r. It is made by combining §9Nevvonian Iron§r, §9Coke§r, §9Diamonds§r, §5Source§r, and §9Liquid Titanium§r. I suggest you batch a decent bit because it might also be used a lot more later.
phoenix_chronicles.task.true_beauty_begi: eighty five percent pure nevonian steel ingot
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_3c7d927ba16e2:
§l§9I Believe I can touch the sky§r§r! At last, §aCreative Flight§r is within your grasp! You might wonder why this ultimate freedom took so long to achieve. The Angel Ring demands considerable effort, specifically requiring §cNether Stars§r – truly an §4IV tier material§r.

Beyond that, you needed to craft the Diamond Ring. This calls for a significant choice: either embark on a challenging journey to §dfind an Elytra§r, or utilize the slightly more §eexpensive Assembler recipe§r for its creation.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.active_transfor:
The §3Active Transformer§r is a multiblock used to transform energy on a much larger scale. For example, you can convert §6HV§r to §7LV§r power directly by using the appropriate energy hatches.

To make it you need to make a §l§6Conductive Honey Coil§r§r block which requires you to challenge §6honey§r.

In base GT: Modern, you would need to get superconductive coils which are unlocked after the NaqLine, but here, I thought we should bring this wonderful multiblock to you even earlier.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o This is yet another feature from TecTech, which also required these cables to be painted. They do look fantastic if you paint them, but it's optional in CEu.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.laser_power_tra:
The §3Active Transformer§r has a second use - §6Laser Power§r. Lasers are like superconductors, but behave slightly differently. They share the energy input across all connected active transformers, allowing widespread power distribution. You can use §3Active Transformers§r to convert regular EU to and from Lasers.

Like optical cables, they can only be connected to §eone input and output§r. But, these ones also only can move in §estraight lines§r. To turn them, an §3Active Transformer§r with a Laser Source Hatch (output) and Target Hatch (input) is needed.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o This is yet again another TecTech feature, but there's a bit more to it this time. TecTech's lasers were tiered by voltage and carried thousands of amps instead. CEu doesn't faff around with any of that tiering. You only need one type of laser here!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_3ea4c57a5fa7c:
This is the §3main food for bees§r, used to breed, collect, and incubate them. The processing line to obtain them is pretty complicated as it requires you to make §6honey§r, §6honeycombs§r, and some other dessert-based materials.

To get §6honeycombs§r you need to solidify honey with a honeycomb base. This base requires §l§9Polymethyl Methacrylate (PMMA)§r, an advanced acrylic used in place of glass in some real-world applications.

You will want to stockpile both §6honeytreats§r and §6honeycombs§r, as well as making a few bases, as they will be used in producing materials using bees a bit later.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_0835e56f62727:
With your first combs produced from the Simulated Colony, it is time to delve into §6advanced processing§r.

First, process the combs into §2Raw Wax Chunks§r.

Next, take the wax chunks to a Brewery (a §9Large Brewing Vat§r is highly recommended!) to transform them into §bHoneyed Wax§r.

Finally, centrifuge the Honeyed Wax to extract valuable §aOres§r and §dImpure Honey§r. Do not forget to put that Impure Honey back into a centrifuge for purification!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.simulated_colon:
Time to start producing some special honeycombs!

This is the first step in §6advanced comb processing§r, using the Simulated Colony multi-block.

The machine requires three key inputs: a §bBee§r (created in the Apis Progenitor), a §aPollination Block§r, and a steady supply of §dSugar Water§r (to feed the bees).

The comb production stage is a significant bottleneck for your processing line, so you will want to deploy numerous bees and §6Simulated Colonies§r to scale up your operation!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_12226c8c23637:
Forget traditional breeding; you §6transform§r bees using matching materials and ores!

§c(A word of advice, the name on the bee cages have to be §9§l§o§nEXACTLY§r §cwhat they say for the recipes/the name of the bee in emi, so if you want to make a bee check the bee name in emi and anvil rename to match)§r§r

You ready to take them on? If so, click here!


This is the most complex phase of the Bee Line, requiring you to find §aSpecial Nests§r in specific biomes. Lure the bees with §bHoney Treats§r (or specialized catalysts for rare nests) to initiate the moving-in process.

Once caged, transform them to begin the §dBee Line§r proper! Remember to check §6EMI§r for catalyst items and required biomes.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_33bf15657aba1:
It is time to upgrade your mob processing! §6Ambering§r is the direct replacement for slow Hostile Neural Networks.

Utilizing the §aSwarm Nurturer§r, you can solidify mob drops using an §bAmber Bee§r.

While these ambered mobs cannot be used until §9LUV§r tier in the Melliferous Matrix, it is wise to start producing them now!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_7025b4400dbd6: You are telling me I can breed power?!

Prepare for a true engineering feat! Your §b§lHigh-Performance Breeder Reactor§r is indeed the cornerstone of §1§lIV§r§r and §d§lLUV§r power, but a single unit won't suffice.

You must construct and operate §6§lseparate High-Performance Breeder Reactors§r for each of your vital breeding chains: one dedicated to the §c§lU-235 line,§r and another for the §9§lU-233 line.§r

Can you build the parallel infrastructure to sustain both critical power paths? Your ultimate energy future depends on it!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_65f07a79bfa0e:
Your factory faces a §e§lnew challenge!§r The first §c§lDriver Fuel for Fissile Breeding§r is here, promising immense power (around §a§l2 ZPM amps per tick§r). But there's a catch: its §6§lrecipe time is extremely low.§r

To craft this fuel, you'll need a §b§lrapid supply§r of §3§lUranium-235§r (from UF6 processing) and a continuous flow of §d§lCryo Zirconium Binding Solution.§r

Can your production lines handle the §e§lblistering speed required,§r or will your breeding efforts §4§lstall?§r
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_1ab48379b96a9:
A new era of breeding awaits! Your Advanced Pressurized Fission Reactor is producing something vital: §e§lLow Level Radioactive Waste Dust.§r This seemingly innocuous byproduct is actually the key to unlocking §a§lThorium!§r

Refine this waste to forge the §b§lThorium Fuel Pellets§r, the essential §9§lblanket fuel§r for both your §c§lU-235§r and §d§lU-233§r breeding lines.

Can you harness the waste and unleash the power of thorium?
phoenix_chronicles.quest.spray_cans.desc:
These are a §6wonderful§r tool to give one of the §a16 base Minecraft dyes§r to any dyeable block (such as wool or §9ae2§r cables). Moreover, if you §aShift-Right-Click§r you can color an area at once.

They can also be used to color GT §claser pipes§r, §6cables§r, §ewires§r, and §bmachines§r.

They also have one more §6unqiue§r effect. When an §aInput/Output Hatch§r or §aBus§r is colored with one of these, it acts distinct from all other colors. What this means, is that if you were to color a §6Bus + Hatch combo§r, that combo would only be able to look for recipe Inputs/Output Space in that color.

Any uncolored hatch/bus is seen as a §6§owildcard§r§r to all others, this is most useful in the Alloy Blast Smelter.

One final thing, if you fill up a spray can with §6Acetone§r, you can use it to §c§odissolve§r§r colors from other cans.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.ultra_high_powe:
The §aUHPIC§r unlocks §3ZPM Energy Hatches§r and §3Dynamos§r.

You may know the drill, but do you know the screwdriver?
phoenix_chronicles.quest.dielectric_pcb_:
§3Dielectric PCB Coolant§r is used to maintain some highly advanced late and end-game machinery.

You only need a little bit in §dLuV§r, but you'll want to automate it when you get to §cZPM§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.naquadahdoped_s:
Doping §9Silicon§r with §9Naquadah§r will give a better §aSilicon Boule§r.

Use it for higher yield on §dWafers§r.

This will also unlock the §6best recipe§r for §6HV§r Circuits in the §3LuV Circuit Assembler§r. You're probably going to want to mass produce these for the many §dLapotronic Energy Orbs§r that'll be required moving forwards.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.naquadah.title: Naquadah
phoenix_chronicles.quest.naquadah.descri:
§aNaquadah§r is a late-game material with a variety of uses. It is required when building a Fusion Reactor and progressing to §cZPM§r, to name a few.

For some reason, its fluid is a brilliant §agreen§r - don't ask us why.

§l§3Lore:§r§o Naquadah is a material originally from Stargate.
Hotter than the surface temperature of the Sun!

§aNaquadah Coils§r crank up the Heat Capacity to §d7,200K§r.

These coils are required for progressing to the second half of §dLuV§r and beyond.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o Well... not some "juicy GregTech lore", but a cool space fact, owing to the fact you're beating the Sun's temperature with your EBF. The surface temperature of the Sun is 5,800K. We're taking this as an effective temperature - i.e. the radiative temperature of the Sun as if it were a perfectly "black body". Check out the Stefan-Boltzmann law if you're interested in some crude astrophysics.

§oOh, and the "photosphere" (the part of the sun we're talking about when we mention its surface)? It's 400 kilometres thick. That's 250 miles. Damn!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.luv_superconduc: Be glad these don't use pumps

§aLuV Superconductors§r are necessary if you're eyeing a §9Fusion Reactor§r.

Don't ignore our warning here - you're gonna need §ea lot§r§r of them. Luckily, any §5Indium§r shortages will be solved by your Naquadah line.

§6§lFret not§r§r all you who seek strong superconductors, §5Extremely Modified Space Grade Steel§r has your back, with §364 amps§r with 1x wires, you can use those §bactive transformers§r you unlocked earlier and really go ham with your §5central power§r! This stuff is also used to make certain §bspecial custom multiblocks§r this tier.
phoenix_chronicles.task.luv_superconduct: indium tin barium titanium cuprate single wire
extremely modified space grade steel single wire
phoenix_chronicles.quest.fluid_of_the_st:
§cWarning§r: §9Plasmas§r are §cextremely hot§r, with temperatures exceeding §d30k Kelvin§r!

However, this §6§ldoesn't§r mean that a special type of pipe is required to transport plasma. Plasmas are treated slightly differently, and bend the rules a bit.

Fluid pipes that can handle plasmas, such as §aTungsten§r, §aNaquadah§r, or §aDuranium§r can hold any plasma §6regardless of temperature§r. This means they §lwon't§r melt under the heat of the plasma!

WARNING:§r Plasmas in incompatible pipes will cause §cvoiding§r, §cpipe burning§r, and §ldisproportionately high§r rates of §cdeath§r. Be careful!

§l§3Lore:§r§o This mechanic originates from GT6, just like the acids!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.large_plasma_tu:
Use this turbine to extract very large amounts of power from plasma!

§aHelium Plasma§r is the best fuel for its cost.

If you're the type to question how realistic Plasma Turbines are... look up Magnetohydrodynamic Generators if you want something that bends fact into fiction.
This is the main material for §cZPM§r. Having this in stock will be a test of your Platinum processing, so this is a §6pre-emptive warning§r to stay on top of mining PGS-bearing ore.

Prepare to make lots... after you make §9Fusion§r and §9Crystal Circuits§r. Tackle those before you try making this.
Refining §9Naquadah§r into further products will be your next automation challenge. The primary outputs of this line are §aEnriched Naquadah§r, §aNaquadria§r, and §aTrinium§r.

This processing line - affectionately known as the "Naqline" - also produces many useful byproducts, such as Titanium and Indium.

---


§aEnriched Naquadah§r currently isn't used for much, but will be integral to power generation in the future.

§aNaquadria§r is a lategame material that you'll want to stockpile for your §3UV§r components.

§aTrinium§r is the material you'll be wanting most right now. You'll use a lot of it to build your first Fusion Reactor, is used for the next set of Coils, and sees heavy usage in most §cZPM§r recipes.

---


§eNote§r: This processing chain presents more of a challenge than any chemistry you've dealt with so far.

As usual, outputs in later steps can be sent back into previous processes... with the caveat that they lose a small amount of fluid with each loop.

This can be challenging to automate. Good luck!

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o Many GregTech iterations have Naquadah processing.

§oThe first was likely Impact, with its own original Naquadah fuel process.

§oGregicality Legacy was hot on its heels with processes for making the Naquadah material (and variants) as well as Fuel.

§oAfter that, GTNH added their own Naquadah processes for the material and fuel.

§oLastly, GTCEu added the process you're about to set up!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.trinium.title: Trinium
phoenix_chronicles.quest.trinium.descrip:
§aTrinium§r is a very important material for progression. You'll need it to make a §9Fusion Reactor§r, but it stays relevant all throughout §cZPM§r. We §7(well, this particular questbook writer!)§r can never have enough of this stuff.

It also requires an §dLuV§r EBF to smelt! Perhaps dedicate a setup solely for cooking this, unless you're confident that your infrastructure can deal with it.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o In Stargate, Trinium was strong enough to block a point-blank C4 explosion. It's considered to be a hundred times stronger than steel, at only one-hundreth the weight.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.plutonium241.de:
§aPlutonium-241§r is yet another requirement for the §9Fusion Reactor§r. It's very easy to make: just centrifuge some §9Pu-239§r to slowly separate some out.

In the future, this material will require a §dNuclear Reactor§r to produce, but that's not in GTCEu yet.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o In GT Impact, making Pu-241 was a challenge. Your first Pu-241 had to be produced as a byproduct of its very expensive Naquadah fuel process, and it could only be made independently with something post-fusion!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.fusion_reactor_:
First things first - build the version of the structure that uses Fusion Glass in §aEMI§r. It's far cheaper right now.

To save on §3Fusion Casings§r, fit Input/Output Hatches wherever you can (as displayed in the structure).

The §bFusion Reactor§r will pick a free Output Hatch from the many that are available. In order to "§6force§r" the Reactor to use a particular Output Hatch, you can always §alock all of the hatches§r to an irrelevant fluid (we usually use §9Water§r).

This time, we'll try something new: we're gonna explain the §3Lore§r at the same time as the mechanics.

Enjoy the ride!

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o GregTech 5's §3Fusion Reactor§f stores EU you feed it in its internal buffer. The maximum capacity is determined by the amount of §3Energy Hatches§f in the structure.

§oRecipes can only start if the §9"EU to start"§f is stored internally, which will be §cconsumed§f. With this stored energy, the reactor can keep running recipes until it goes idle. At this point it will need to be topped up on EU to start again.

---


§oShadow of Greg's §3Fusion Reactor§f (which is now GTCEu's Fusion Reactor) comes with an added mechanic called §4Heat§f.

§oWhen the reactor is running, the §9EU to start§f is converted to §4Heat§f. That Heat is preserved until the Reactor goes idle, at which point it will slowly go down.

§oNext time a recipe is found, it will use all possible Heat and deduct it from the §9EU to start§f, allowing you to save Energy for short pauses.

§oThe §3Fusion Reactor I§f can only run recipes up to a required EU of 160 MEU to start. It will also overclock up to §dLuV§f at best, even if you upgrade to ZPM Hatches, so don't stress over attempting this.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.europium.title: Europium
phoenix_chronicles.quest.europium.descri:
§aEuropium§r is the first major Fusion Material. You'll be using this quite a lot going forwards.

§eNote§r: The temperature of liquid Europium is very hot, but the fluid isn't a plasma. Plan your piping accordingly!

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o In Gregicality Legacy, Europium was replaced with Rutherfordium as the first fusion material, because Europium is actually found in Rare Earth and isn't fused in real life.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.crystal_cpu.sub: These don't even make any sense!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.crystal_cpu.des:
§aCrystal CPUs§r are used to produce §9Crystal Circuits§r - who would have thought?

Producing these is quite a bit different from the previous circuit components. Instead of standard silicon wafers, these rely on §9Emerald§r or §9Olivine§r.

Getting your first Crystal Chips will be difficult, so you may wish to invest in a high-tier Autoclave. If you use a §6HV§r Autoclave... well, we didn't take you for the gambling sort.

After you get your first Chip, you can duplicate them with §9Europium§r. Don't worry about those other recipes yet, they're for later on in §cZPM§r.

---


§eNote§r: An §9Advanced Item Detector§r cover will be useful for automating these. They work just like the Advanced Energy Detector.

§l§3Lore:§r§o In GT5u modpacks, making your first Crystal Chips required the autoclave to be in Low Gravity, which meant doing this process on a Galacticraft Space Station, or on the moon!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.upgrading_your_:
This Quest will be completed with §eeither§r an §3LuV Energy Hatch§r§r... or an §3LuV Dynamo Hatch§r for your Multiblock Generators.

Starting at §dLuV§r, you'll start upgrading more multiblocks, which means more energy hatches! Both the §9EBF§r and the §9Assembly Line§r will need power upgrades.

Don't forget that §d4 Amp§r variants exist!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.the_power_of_wi: The §aWireless Connector§r will help with logistics, giving §9Wireless Transfer§r for your ME Network with unlimited range. The energy cost scales exponentially with transfer distance.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.packagedwho.des:
If recipe sizes are starting to worry you, don't worry - §2AE2§r now allows you to place an unlimited amount of items into a processing pattern.

Thanks to this innovation, you can automate all the §3Assembly Line§r recipes.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.ludicrous_fluid:
At the cost of 16x the drilling Power, the §3Advanced Fluid Drilling Rig II§r will be gaining §664x the output§r in Fluid.
The depletion of veins is also slashed to an eighth of what it was before. This means you will get a total of §6128x§r as much Oil (or whatever fluid) as the regular rig from a bedrock fluid vein until depletion!

Even when depleted, you can safely use this and be very much power positive.

One single §3Advanced Fluid Drilling Rig II§r should be enough to last you until the end of the game, for whatever fluid you drill.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.ludicrous_ore_d:
This Large Miner is nearly identical to the regular one, except it has a wider range and uses more drilling fluid.

It's an optional sidegrade - one you might not even want.

§l§3Lore:§r§o There may be a rebalance for these in the future. See the Multiblock Miner quest for details.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.ludicrous_batte:
The §aLuV Lapotronic Orb§r is even better than the §1IV§r one! Of course, such power comes at a steep cost...

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o In older versions of GT, such as GTNH in the past or in GCYL, these orbs were ludicrously expensive! They required 8 orbs of the previous tier! Thankfully, those days are long past.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.even_more_luv_c: Cheaper §dLuV§r circuits! These'll take some of the edge out of those brutal Robot Arm recipes.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.more_zpm_circui:
§cZPM§r Circuits that aren't mainframes!

Don't lie - §bCrystal Supercomputers§r sound really cool, right?
If you're yet to strike gold, you will now
The §aLuV Electric Prospector§r is a major upgrade from the §eHV§r one. With its huge range, it'll make finding Fluid and Ore veins very easy.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.best_iv_circuit: I know where this is going!

The first circuit of the §9Crystal§r line.

§l§3Lore:§r§o The concept of a Crystal Circuit has existed since the very early versions of GregTech. We're still not entirely sure if they exist in real life.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.multilayer_fibe:
If you say the name 3 times in front of a mirror, you summon a CEu dev.

§aMulti-Layer Fiber-Reinforced Printed Circuit Boards§r are the next step in your circuit journey. They're not particularly interesting compared to the previous boards: just two of the previous stuck together.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o In Gregicality Legacy, these circuit boards were much more complicated. They required Kapton, a dual polymer material. It was a challenge to say the least. In the future, the GTCEu team might make these boards somewhat more involved to produce.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.pure_joy.title: Pure Joy
phoenix_chronicles.quest.pure_joy.descri:
§dLuV§r Components are significantly more difficult to produce than their predecessors. They require an §9Assembly Line§r, many different forms of materials, and lots of fluids too!

You will notice that §9Samarium§r is required for §aLuV+ Motors§r. Samarium by itself isn't very difficult to obtain, but smelting it is slightly more involved. It requires §9Liquid Helium§r in the Freezer. If you made §9IV Superconductors§r, you've likely seen this already.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o In the original GregTech 5, these components were unobtainable! You'd be free from GT if you were at this point! How times change.
They call me 007 - 0 Naquadah, 0 EU/t, 7 TPS

The chances you are having TPS issues playing this modpack are slim - this Quest is more suited for late game bases with GregTech and AE2.

If you run the command §9/forge tps§r, you will be given the current §4TPS§r and the §4tick time§r in milliseconds.

If the tick time exceeds 50ms, the server is under too much load, and won't be able to keep up with a steady 20 TPS.

Any machine will add up to the tick time, but don't be too scared of adding machines. Most of the lag usually comes from things that are unoptimized.

---


Things to §cavoid§r in general:

§9-§r Entities are pretty bad. Ground items or mob entities should be kept as low as possible at any given time. Thankfully, this shouldn't be an issue in this modpack.

§9-§r Building everything packed together in a small space. Note that this does §onot§r affect TPS, but you will suffer FPS drops instead.

§9-§r Huge walls of drawers, as iterating through every single one of them for insertion and extraction can be pretty taxing.

---


Things to§c avoid§r with AE2:

§9-§r ME Import and Export Buses on large networks. Use ME Interfaces instead.

§9-§r Crafting Cards to passively do large requests.

§9-§r Recursive insertion and/or extraction through sub-networks. If you use sub-networks, make them do very specific things rather than interacting with another AE2 network.

---


Things to §cavoid§r with GregTech (GTCEu has received a lot of improvements over GTCE, but it is possible to destroy your TPS, as with any mod):

§9-§r Many EU Producers connected to many EU Consumers in the same line. Instead, use a Diode or Battery Buffer to separate your line of generators to your line of machines.

§9-§r Large amounts of Fluid Pipes. They are §onot§r laggy individually, but they can add up if you have thousands of them.

§9-§r Big Item Pipe networks. Small networks are better, to reduce the number of iterations over inventories.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.iv_magnetism.de:
§aMagnetic Samarium§r (which you'll need for your §dLuV§r components) requires an §3IV Polarizer§r.

Even so, we hope you weren't running all the polarization off a single §6HV§r Polarizer. Were you?
phoenix_chronicles.quest.infinite_wirele: The §aQuantum Bridge Card§r is an upgrade to the §9Quantum Link Tunnel§r, which gives §9Wireless Terminals§r access to your AE system with unlimited range, and from any dimension.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.best_flight.sub: I'll be seeing you in the skies!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.best_flight.des:
The Advanced Quantum Chestplate combines protection, a personal battery and an §6ultimate Jetpack§r into a single powerful piece of gear.

Note that this stores §oa lot§r of energy. You may want to invest in an §3LuV Turbo Charger§r.

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o This armor piece is inspired by the IndustrialCraft  Addon Gravisuite, which added the Gravitation Suit, analogous to this chestplate.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.two_hatches_for: Two Hatches for the Price of One

New in the §a1.4 update§r, Dual Hatches will greatly help with automation with Multiblocks.

They can contain both §6Fluids and Items simultaneously§r, meaning you can simply connect a §bPattern Provider§r and be off to the races. No more faffing around with P2P or Buffers!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.pattern_modifie:
Let's go over some uses!

§2Blank Pattern Storage:§r

Right-clicking with the tool in your hand will open a GUI where you can insert §9Blank Patterns§r. There's a considerable amount of storage space for transport of Patterns!

---


§2Bulk Pattern Modification:§r

Inserting §9Encoded Patterns§r instead of blank ones will allow you to multiply/divide them all at once in bulk. This is particularly useful when multiplying up your Patterns for parallel on-demand machinery.

Patterns can also be cleared in bulk with the "Clear" button. There isn't any confirmation after clicking it, so use with caution.

---


§2Item Search and Replace:§r

Right-clicking the tool and clicking the §aChange Mode button§r will bring up a new GUI. This GUI will allow you to replace all occurances of one item with another for the §9Encoded Patterns§r stored within the tool.

This is particularly useful for §eupgrading GT circuits§r, such as transitioning from Nano to Quantum §5EV§r circuits.

---


§2Easy Pattern Transfer:§r

Shift-left-clicking Patterns will move them between the Player Inventory and the Modifier where possible. This means you can easily move Patterns around between Interfaces and Terminals without clogging your inventory.

---


§bLore§r: Neeve, the author of the NAE2 mod suggested tiering this item at §eUXV§r tier, because it "gives the player way too much power." For reference, §eUXV§r is 4 tiers past §3UV§r tier - two tiers before §c§lMAX§r voltage.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_25e859663cf87:
A machine that makes §6bees produce resources very fast§r. However, this power requires some preperation. Because of this, I hope you started bees back in §eIV§r.

This wonderful machine can also use the §9WannaBee§r, a very powerful bee that uses §eambered mobs§r to generate §d mob drops§r.

This is the direct replacement to §cHostile Neural Networks§r since I have blacklisted the §8simulation chamber§r from GT's §7world accelerator§r.

What, you mean you really did not do bees? §aRude.§r


---


"You stumble upon a §8note pad§r. It seems to be research from a §c§llost scientist§r, his name is familiar yet foreign to you at the same time?

A man crazy in love with bees named {#FF0000}§lDevil§r?

Whoever he was he has indescribably disappeared almost as if he became one with the §6bees§r. His research pad whilst ancient has some pages left in it.

It describes a machine capable of harnessing the power of §6bees§r to produce resources to help reclaim §2PhoenixWare's§r once lost greatness."
phoenix_chronicles.quest.mass_data_stora:
The §3Data Bank§r is a multiblock capable of storing huge amounts of data. You can fill it with §aData Access Hatches§r, and fill those with §aData Storage Items§r.

After that, you'll need power, and then a way to connect it to your Assembly Line! This is done through §3Optical Fiber Cables§r, which can be used to link §3Optical Data Hatches together§r.

---


An §9Optical Transmission Hatch§r is used to send data (like an output), and an §9Optical Reception Hatch§r to recieve the data (like an input).

Optical cables have some restrictions however. They can only connect §eone input to one output§r. The Data Bank is your answer to this, since you can place many hatches on them to route your data anywhere.

You can use this behavior to §echain§r Data Banks as well. Connecting one Data Bank to another, and then one of them to an Assembly Line will provide the data of both banks!

---


§eNote: §rThis multiblock will be required later on in progression, but is very useful to set up early.

§l§3Lore:§r§o This multiblock also originates from TecTech, but part of its mechanics required optical cables to be painted as well. You don't have to do that here, but it looks really nice if you do!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_0846d43188314:
Ascend to the pinnacle of power! Your §d§lLUV U-233 Fuel§r is the key to unparalleled energy, boasting §a§lsignificantly higher efficiency§r than its U-235 counterpart. What's more, it produces a §f§l§otasty 2 §2UV§r amps§r!

However, do not abandon your roots! The §c§lU-235 line§r remains indispensable: it must continue to provide the initial §9§lU-233§r to kickstart this powerful new chain, and perhaps even more critically, supply the §b§lUranium-236§r derived from its §e§ldepleted uranium waste.§r

Master this intricate symbiotic relationship and secure your ultimate LUV power!
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_6254ef241b1f3: The §3Pyrolyse Oven§r is an stronger variant to the §3Cracker§r. It can produce §9Coal Coke§r, §9Charcoal§r with a §9Creosote§r byproduct, and just as before, §6Organic Byproducts§r faster. With it's ability to use a §o§l§6Parallel Control Hatch§r§r§r, this wonderful upgrade to your wood processing will have you rip and raring. I hope you are ready to §c§lBring The Heat!§r
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_11a1a002df53b:
Have you ever wondered why the §8cracker§r is so §4painfully slow§r?

Some people have even stooped so low as to use the §9Large Chemical Reactor§r to crack their §ehydrocarbons§r even with the §c§lhalf loss§r because of its §aPerfect Overclock§r.

However, now you are ready to become the §6king of petrochem§r and crack all your products at §badvanced speeds§r, ones you have only once dreamed of.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_1efd372d07489:
The §b§lUranium-236 Fuel Blanket§r represents a new era of nuclear alchemy. While its power output is respectable, its true value lies in its transformative power. When used alongside a §d§lPlutonium-241 Driver§r, it acts as a §9§lreactor blanket§r, converting §f§ldepleted fuel waste§r into incredibly valuable §a§lbyproducts§r, unlocking a new level of resource generation.

Harness the potential of this symbiotic relationship and §e§lmaster the waste!§r
phoenix_chronicles.quest.q_3509c91be9514: It's not a red hot candy, trust me

Behold the §d§lPlutonium-241 Fuel Driver§r, the §l§4beating heart§r of the ultimate reactor! This pellet represents a §b§lquantum leap§r in energy generation, providing an immense surge of power far beyond any previous fuel line. It is the §l§cengine§r that supercharges the §9§lUranium-236 blanket§r, allowing for a torrent of power and valuable byproducts to be created.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.zero_point_modu:
The §aZero Point Module§r (item) is a non-rechargable battery with TONS of energy stored. You may have found one of these before now, but you haven't been able to discharge it until reaching §cZPM§r.

These can only be found as loot from §6Jungle Temples§r. They're exceptionally rare - don't worry about finding one.

This quest is §6optional§r and is just for fun. Feel free to hit the checkbox if you just want the completion points!

---


§l§3Lore:§r§o Zero Point Module, the full name of the ZPM tier, is also from Stargate. Its namesake is a device which generated crazy amounts of energy.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.zpm_superconduc: Getting tired of all these pitch-black ingots yet?

§aZPM Superconductors§r are a major gate between you and a §9Fusion Reactor Mk2§r, which uses copious amounts for its structure blocks.

You can also use them to make §9Superconducting Coils§r for cheaper.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.absolute_elatio:
§cZPM§r Components thankfully aren't too much harder than §dLuV§r.

They use lots of §9Osmiridium§r, so make sure your platinum refining process is up to the task.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.enriched_naquad:
§aEnriched Naquadah§r is an isotope of Naquadah, Nq-528. It is radioactive and will be used in (as of yet) unimplemented nuclear reactors.

Currently, you just need it to make §9Trinium Coils§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.trinium_coils.d:
§aTrinium Coils§r bring up the Heat Capacity to §d9,001K§r.

These coils are required for progressing to the second half of §cZPM§r, and beyond.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.research_statio:
The §3Research Station§r is the upgrade to the Scanner. It's used for more advanced forms of research, and will finally allow you to perform research which requires §aData Orbs and Modules§r.

When running the §3Research Station§r, energy and §9Computation§r is needed. The latter is provided through an §9HPCA§r, which is explained in the next quest. It is recieved with a §3Computation Data Reception Hatch§r. Note that only one Reception Hatch is allowed in a Research Station.

---


This multiblock needs computation §dsporadically§r, which means the recipe will not reverse progress if you don't supply enough - it will simply halt in-place. However, the machine will still draw energy constantly, even when recieving no computation.

To scan items, the process is relatively similar. In the §3Object Holder§r, place the target item in the center slot, and the data storage item in the other slot. Then provide computation, and the data storage item will be updated upon completion. When running, the target item will be Locked and cannot be removed.

§eNote§r: To form this multiblock, the §3Object Holder§r must face the controller.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.first_uv_circui:
The §aUV Mainframe§r is required to move into §3Fusion Mk2§r.

It's also made in the Assembly Line.

Passing over the ingredients we've already seen before, watch out for the §6HSS-E Frames§r.
phoenix_chronicles.quest.crystal_soc.sub: When engraving it once isn't enough
phoenix_chronicles.quest.crystal_soc.des:
The §aCrystal SoC§r is used to make cheaper §9Crystal Circuits§r. Enjoy the discount!
